# dataiku_project (Data Source)

Reads a single Dataiku DSS project by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dataiku_project" "analytics" {
  project_key = "ANALYTICS"
}

output "analytics_owner" {
  value = data.dataiku_project.analytics.owner
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) Key of the project to read.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Long description of the project.
- `id` (String) The project key.
- `name` (String) Display name of the project.
- `owner` (String) Login of the project owner.
- `short_desc` (String) Short description of the project.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied to the project.
